items.intro_words: All right, roll call, please. Trustee Wells.
Welcome, everyone, to. Let's see. It's November 17, 2021.
Welcome by the School Board President
Do I have any changes to the agenda? I have one three proposed changes.
Do I have a motion to approve? So moved.
All right, so we're on to the bond program consent items.
All right, 7.4. Does anyone have any questions on this resolution?
All right, so we're on to 8.1. Discussion of reconvening North Star Forward Committee.
Right, okay, so we're on to 8.2. We're on to the presentation regarding potential trustee area revision.
So back to the food service to kind of just close out that conversation because we had heard from the presenters and we heard from those who wanted to comment to the board and staff.
All right, so we are on to. We have a number of board policies in front of you.
Adjournment - Do I have a motion to adjourn?
